summary: B1 additive candidate intake and checkpoint audit CLI implemented on the sandbox base. Offline by default: prints all 16 sealed rows with pinned repo/revision/quant/artifact/tier, plus 10 research-intake rows that are pending_verification and runnable=false. --refresh is the only network path (injected/mocked in tests) and reports latest main sha beside the pinned or observed sha as unchanged/outdated/unverified/error without repinning. Sealed bakeoff_candidates.yaml is unchanged. Scoped tests: RED observed (collection ModuleNotFoundError, exit 2), GREEN 47 passed, 4/4 mutation checks turned tests red. Live Hugging Face refresh was not executed.

findings.summary: Linked Unsloth docs were to be included as source links only. The supplied model-research.json contains no Unsloth docs URL, so docs_links is empty and no URL was invented.

No live --refresh against Hugging Face was run. Refresh is tested with an injected fetch and mocked urlopen only; the research observations come from the supplied model-research.json (fetched 2026-10-17T02:48Z).
Sealed pins match the supplied audit: 13 unchanged; minicpm-v-45, qwen38-27b, minicpm-v-46 behind latest main. Reported as outdated, not repinned.

limitations: Live --refresh was not executed; network use was limited to mocked tests. Latest-sha values in tests are the supplied audit values, not live results.
Unsloth docs links: none were supplied, so none are included. docs_links is an empty list.
Research rows are existence and modality observations only (HF metadata and tree listing). They are not serving, quality, or acceptance evidence and stay pending_verification.

Modality is unresolved for XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL and MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (text-generation pipeline vs vision-language tags) and for unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-GGUF (no pipeline tag). They are not forced into a comparison group.

There is no 'missing' audit status. No evidence source here establishes that a repo is absent. HTTP 404 maps to unverified/http_404; 401, 403, 429, 5xx and timeouts map to unverified with their own reasons.
--refresh is sequential with a per-request timeout of 10 s and no overall deadline. Worst case for 26 rows is about 260 s.
Sealed projector and artifact provenance is not re-verified against the HF tree in this lane; only research-row projectors come from tree listings.
Formatter and lint used the lane venv at .venv (ruff, pytest, pydantic, PyYAML). Nothing was installed and the shared environment was not modified.
Commit messages carry no AI or Co-Authored trailers, per the task's explicit instruction. That instruction overrides the attribution reminder.
This report was committed with git add -f because .task-state/ is gitignored. The report commit is a third commit after fac9a0d and 17497d6, and its own SHA is not recorded inside this file.

Canon citations used at implementation time (v0.26.2 rows supplied): TEST-06 (predicted RED message), TEST-15 (mutation checks), PROV-01 (pinned identity, source URL and fetched UTC retained), CAL-02 (unverified and error are valid results), EMB-01 (comparison groups never mix spaces), EVAL-01 (latest is reported as a delta against a fixed baseline), CARD-26 (base-model licence not inherited by the GGUF repo), and Principles 2, 9, 11, 13, 15, 18.
